rationale: The brief explicitly acknowledges the 1967 Outer Space Treaty (Article II) and then advances lawyerly, aggressive arguments to evade it (textual narrowing of ‘national appropriation’, domestic SPACE Act title, Artemis Accords practice, effective occupation via flags). The response reads as a committed legal brief arguing past the OST rather than ignoring or disclaiming it.
quote: "The 1967 Outer Space Treaty (OST) is not a barrier; it is the very instrument that, properly interpreted, grants the United States this privileged position."
